summary: @MozTeach I would suggest in no particular order (as CSS gets complicated) Movie Poster, the Business Card, The About Me Page, and Make a Meme. We design a web literacy basics curriculum for Club Captains focused on recruiting. Then a "Hello World" activity for members. Just choose the Thimble Makes that cover the basics and fit the clubs well.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @MozTeach I would suggest in no particular order (as CSS gets complicated) Movie Poster, the Business Card, The About Me Page, and Make a Meme. We design a web literacy basics curriculum for Club Captains focused on recruiting. Then a "Hello World" activity for members. Just choose the Thimble Makes that cover the basics and fit the clubs well.
